title: Exploring Multilingual Concepts of Human Values in Large Language Models: Is Value Alignment Consistent, Transferable and Controllable across Languages?
reasoning: The paper focuses on how human values and ethical concepts—specifically deontology, utilitarianism, and commonsense morality—are encoded and aligned within LLMs. It utilizes ethics-based datasets like the ETHICS dataset to evaluate these models and includes a dedicated section on the ethical theories and moral frameworks that ground its research.
